Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer agent failed to extract the birthplace from the search results. Although the search results clearly displayed "André Beaunier (22 September 1869, Évreux - 9 December 1925, Paris)" in the Wikipedia snippet, the agent incorrectly stated that it "identified the birthplace as Paris, France." It confused the place of death (Paris) with the place of birth (Évreux), leading to an erroneous initial conclusion that required multiple subsequent correction loops.
